Teen Patti Points Tracker

Record what each player put into the pot and who won. Running totals and an end-of-night settlement are calculated for you.

Loading tracker…

How it works

For each round, enter the points each player put into the pot and tap the winner. The winner gains the whole pot minus their own share; everyone else loses what they put in. Optionally note the winning hand to keep a record of the night's best hands.

This tracker counts points only — use whatever chips or tokens your group plays with. Check the Teen Patti hand rankings if there's an argument over who won.
